title: give the UI pass a named render hook, so renders need no overlay test file written by the role

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-130509-4fa3, project ork, item S392:

give the UI pass a named render hook, so renders need no overlay test file written by the role

Evidence: the project has no render command; I used go test -overlay with a temp test file that calls launchHarness, launchConfirmed and plainView
